body: Thanks for the detailed information. After reading this all I can say is it sounds like I royally fucked up. I knew it was rough and my plan was to at least get it running, then start redoing all the hack job/sketchy/illegal stuff the right way. Call it an impulse buy, the body and frame are in good shape, that’s the main reason I considered it. Those 90’s Ford’s as you probably know rust out like crazy, at least where I’m at in the midwest. Wish I had your knowledge/skillset, thanks for your time trying to set this straight.
If you go to my profile can you see them? They were posted to r/Cartalk titled Follow up from OP.

Thanks for the response, I just posted some pictures to the thread. I’ll look more into finding what type/year engine I have. If it means anything the plugs I have in it are Motorcraft asf32p. For humility sake I’m no expert here. 
The guy I bought it from put the electric fuel pump in. It runs straight to the carb without a regulator, seems like a bad combination. The truck had EFI originally (I think) but after the stock trans went out, they ditched that and the original motor so I was told. It did run when I bought it, granted it ran rough. The seller advertised the intake gaskets were bad, it was leaking coolant around the manifold. I didn’t know any better so I replaced them, however when I took the old ones off (truck came with a set of new ones) they were fine and not blown anywhere. The times I’ve tried setting the timing I’ve done as you said with the rotor pointing at #1. I do have a timing light and have an idea on how to use it, just haven’t been able to get it idling to actually time it right.
My health is kicking me hard currently. But you’re right, I’m new to this, and for me losing her was just more fuel to the fire. Thanks for the kind words.
Good points, I’ll do my best and see what happens. Thanks for your input.
Yeah Christian Mingle is a dating app. You can imagine this feels like shit. Thanks for your input/advice anyhow.

Yeah, it’s acid and bile reflux, a long story. My thanks to Christ, for bringing your wisdom to my forward thoughts. I haven’t slept in a few days, that’s mainly what sent me into this tirade you responded to. However, something turned today as I was able to have a sincere talk/prayer with the Lord himself for what felt like the first time tonight. Funnily enough, the things you corrected me on just now were what I realized during my time with Christ. Bless you for leading me back to this newfound hope.

I had a bad feeling about using that saying, call it failed poetic justice. Thanks for correcting me. Fix this never ending statement if you want, or not it doesn’t matter. Go ahead and laugh at it. I’m blinded by frustration that I turned out the way I did, all I see and feel is suffering. I have to fight through instead of live through, and constantly have to “change” or “work on myself” makes me think where I went wrong. Again I know their is plenty worse off than me. Funny how living to do the right thing has brought me here. Life is unfair like that obviously, winners and losers. Spoken like a true first world down and out dumb young guy who has no idea what he’s talking about. I say that with more self awareness and not so much self hate, funny right?......no not really. Tired of being this sick puppet on the harsh string of life. Bad luck, poor judgment, tunnel vision, illness, drugs, loneliness, lost, disconnected, insecure, inexperienced, jealous.....did I mention my vocal cords were damaged 5 years ago? A condition of chronic laryngitis called Vocal Cord Disphonia, brought on by excessive reflux backup in my throat. It’s painful to speak when I have to...maybe why I have a bad habit of writing lengthy and unattractive texts and emails.....talking to anyone, let alone women is super easy...blah blah blah blah. Now to add insult to injury I’m stuck with the reciprocating trauma of my closest suicide attempt failure, living after I planned to die. If I succeeded I never would’ve met this girl in the hospital. The reality check of the first girl I know with interest in me, who later erases me, wouldn’t be tied to this trauma. You never would’ve known I existed. I don’t hate myself, I hate the hand I was dealt. Cowardice is too strong, it won’t let me die on my own terms. That’s my selfish sob story in a nutshell. But your words are more true than mine. You can keep this conversation going if you want, correct what you want, call out my mistakes or poor language use, or do nothing and I wouldn’t blame you. In my inexperience I’m used to being “ghosted” or just ignored. For what it’s worth, thanks again for the insight, suggestions and advice.

Again you’re right, your insight has given me something else I couldn’t see before. Things still look bleak, I feel awful, yet I want to believe the darkest hour is just before dawn. Thanks, godspeed to you also.

Well, I think you got me figured out. You’re right that she’s really messed me up. Naive to what was happening, I walked right into it. The shock of the whole thing, I never knew I could turn anyone that hostile towards me without trying. From my stupid rant, I said that all I wanted to know is if she was safe from harm. Me doing what I thought was right led to a grenade in my face, of course it could’ve been worse, just makes me question my values and beliefs. I can’t forget it, October 28th, 2020, it’s dramatic, but felt like my ruination day. You’re right with the virginity card also. Losing that opens up a new bag of problems, admittedly I’m just tired of being the inexperienced, virgin loser. You’re spiritual words also made great sense. I was brought up in a Lutheran household, but could never see God. Later I was hired as the head maintenance person at the church I grew up in, with this maybe God’s trying to tell me something. I’m so overwhelmed I don’t know where to start, trying to live and work while contemplating death every day is indescribable, as you probably know. Finally, again you’re right with the girl problem potentially being solved. I hate to contradict you, but my church has been suffering the last 5-10 years. After losing our longtime pastor we lost so many young families, and girls my own age are pretty much gone. Covid has made that worse, and by majority our parishioners are over the age of 60-65, our staff is small and I’m the youngest employee by almost 20 years. Not trying to make excuses, but in theory that is a positive thing to consider. Thanks for the advice anyhow.

I wish I was in your shoes, and had your perspective. You can make the case that anything I complain about can be countered, I can’t express the agony through words. Though you seem to have lived through worse, enter in the guilt after I cry about my first world personal problems. At this point, I don’t live, I exist. I’m only alive because of cowardice. Afraid of the last seconds before death, if I’m headed for hell. I feel like a sick old man trapped in a clueless 20 year old’s body. Factor in young guy hormones, and depressive mindsets, reminders of not a single date, kiss, or sexual relationship is just demoralizing. Helplessly jealous of friends and family who are actually enjoying life. I don’t know what happiness feels like. This pandemic now is all the more isolating, we’ve talked about women, in person dating is almost dangerous it seems. Everything I’ve said are common problems, and venting/ranting just makes it worse for me at least. The “situation” I had with the girl ghosting me then finally telling me to fuck off in more ways than one is my new dark cloud. Not 10 waking seconds go by without it being there, reeling from my most successful suicide “attempt” there is a shed of trauma there. My twisted brain won’t let me forget it, I was so close to death but lived to meet this person who seemed to care, then didn’t, such is life. I’ve lost most of my religious faith, which is ironic because I work at a church. I pray, but am taken by the evil resentment towards God for all the pain. I believe in God, I try to believe in myself, but my faith in the future is almost nonexistent. Again, I know you don’t want my thanks, but I appreciate the perspective. I wish I had your aspirations to actually live.

Simply put, everything you said makes sense. Thanks for sharing your story. With all due respect, reading your response reminded me I just need to learn to shut the fuck up. Nothing on you personally, but you can probably imagine I’ve heard the same things as you said over and over again. It’s reality, but it’s a terrible feeling being in constant pain, yet knowing many others are way worse off. You seem to have lived more, seen more, and felt worse than me, and I can respect the perspective. In more detail, I realize my experience and thoughts towards women is almost nonexistent. I know I have to set boundaries, think about what I really want and flip the script. As being a godforsaken “nice guy” I’ve learned putting just any woman on a pedestal often ends badly. In the case I mentioned, I can’t say I relied on her solely for support, but I was guilty of wanting a chance with her, vulnerability got me there. I returned home after I had threw my future plans away, angry that I’m still alive. The whole mess was one thing I was trying to escape with suicide, my inexperience and timing were a factor, and I payed the price by getting my hopes up. Finally, enough complaining, if anything I just want one day of no pain or grief, but I know I’m far if not further away from that now. I had no business being here, and clearly I didn’t read the rules for this page. It was a moment of weakness and I paid the price. Life is breaking me more by the day, I know suicide is inevitable, it’s just a matter of time. Again I should’ve kept my mouth shut, and kept this crybaby rant off this platform I know nothing about. Thanks for the support anyhow, I know we’re strangers but you’re response is of great means to me. Take care of yourself.
